title: Enterprise AI Guardrails, Prompt Shield & Content Moderation Architecture Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Naive Regex & Keyword Blacklists Only
tiers.architecture: Static regex/keyword matching on input and output without semantic jailbreak or groundedness models

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Synchronous Frontier LLM-as-a-Judge Before & After Generation (`Serial GPT-4o Guard`)
tiers.architecture: Blocking user request on a frontier LLM safety call before main LLM + buffering entire response for a post-hoc LLM judge

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Sequential Pre-Call + Post-Call Small Guard Models (`Llama-Guard-3-8B / Cloud Safety API` in Serial)
tiers.architecture: Running input Prompt Shield sequentially before main LLM start + running output check every chunk in serial

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Parallel Speculative Input Shield (`Azure Prompt Shields / DeBERTa + Llama-Guard`) + Async Sliding-Window SSE Stream Gate
tiers.architecture: Fire Input Guardrail in parallel with main LLM Prefill (cancel stream before 1st token if unsafe -> `18ms` net TTFT impact) + Async Sentence-Boundary NLI Groundedness & Output Guard

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating the 2,450ms 'Serial Guardrail Tax' on Streaming Voice & Chat Copilots
scenarios.question: Customer service Copilot requires both input jailbreak detection and output policy checking, but serial guardrails add 380ms–2,450ms to P99 TTFT
scenarios.model_answer: Use Speculative Parallel Execution: AI Gateway dispatches the user prompt to the main LLM and the Input Prompt Shield (`Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields / Llama-Guard-3-8B`) simultaneously; because the 85ms shield finishes before the 70B LLM's 280ms prefill, safe requests pay only 18ms net TTFT overhead while unsafe prompts abort the stream before the first token leaves the gateway!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 waits 1,100ms for an input judge + buffers the full output for 1,350ms (`2,450ms` added TTFT, breaking streaming UX); Tier 3 adds `380ms` serial delay.

scenarios.scenario: Defeating Indirect Prompt Injection Hidden Inside Retrieved RAG Documents (`Spotlighting`)
scenarios.question: A retrieved external web page or resume contains Base64/rot13 or role-play instructions attempting to hijack the RAG summarizer
scenarios.model_answer: Combine Delimited Spotlighting (`Azure Prompt Shields Indirect Attack Detector` + `DeBERTa-v3` classifier) that scores untrusted RAG chunks separately from the user's trusted system prompt (`99.4%` block rate, `0.6%` false positives)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 regex misses Base64/multilingual jailbreaks (`31.5%` block rate) while falsely blocking 14.2% of legitimate cybersecurity/medical queries.

scenarios.scenario: Real-Time Streaming Output Moderation & RAG Hallucination Groundedness Check
scenarios.question: During SSE token streaming, the model begins fabricating a policy refund guarantee orCompetitor disparagement not present in the RAG context
scenarios.model_answer: Sliding-Window Sentence-Boundary Stream Gate buffers only 12–20 tokens at punctuation boundaries and evaluates a lightweight NLI Groundedness + Topic Classifier (`< 25ms` on GPU), circuit-breaking the stream if an ungrounded financial promise is detected (`97.8%` catch rate)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 has `0.0%` hallucination detection; Tier 2 disables token streaming entirely to wait for full-response evaluation.

scenarios.scenario: Build vs. Buy: Cloud Managed Guardrails (`Azure Content Safety / Bedrock Guardrails`) vs. Self-Hosted `NeMo / Llama-Guard`
scenarios.question: When should an enterprise use Cloud-Managed Content Safety APIs versus self-hosting `Llama-Guard-3 / NeMo Guardrails` on Kubernetes?
scenarios.model_answer: Below 15M requests/month, Cloud Managed Guardrails (`Azure AI Content Safety / AWS Bedrock Guardrails`) win on zero-ops speed; above 30M requests/month or under strict air-gapped residency, co-locating quantized `DeBERTa + Llama-Guard-3-8B` on local L40S GPUs cuts guardrail TCO from $186K/mo to $29K/mo (-84.4%)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 burns $186K/mo calling a frontier model twice for every single user turn.

perturbation_checks.perturbed: 99.1% Block Rate | 19.5ms Added TTFT (Pre-Tokenizer Normalization + Embedding Classifier)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Parallel Speculative Input Prompt Shield + Async Sliding-Window SSE Stream Gate + NLI Groundedness Verifier) achieves 99.4% jailbreak block rate and 97.8% hallucination catch rate while adding only 18.0ms to P99 TTFT (vs 2,450ms for serial frontier LLM judges).
Firing the input guardrail in parallel with main-model prefill hides the 85ms classifier latency inside the main LLM's 280ms prefill window, aborting unsafe streams before the first token is emitted.
Replacing serial frontier LLM-as-a-Judge guardrails with parallel specialized guard models cuts monthly guardrail TCO across 45M requests from $186K to $29K (-84.4%).
